name: Brave Search MCP Server
summary: Official MCP server for the Brave Search API: web, local, image, video and news search plus LLM context and summarization (stdio or HTTP).
description: Replaces the archived Brave Search server from the MCP reference repo. Published on npm as `@brave/brave-search-mcp-server`; defaults to STDIO since v2.

agent_access.notes: Requires a Brave Search API key.
